# Evening capture

Read `.github/routine-guidance.md` and follow it. Offer a short prompt to capture a note, event, or task from today. Do not infer completion or create an entry without user-supplied content and a request to record it. If the user supplies an entry to record, follow `/log` and preserve its date and signifiers. Give one primary next action, or let the user skip.
